acceptance: 測試以完整決策矩陣證明 auto 的 local/felix 選擇與 reason codes 穩定，explicit felix 無法繞 capability、sandbox或production admission，未知／stale probe fail closed 到 local；命令列沒有 raw argv／shell／ssh host／IP／remote path surface，固定launcher以literal argv array、shell=false啟動，job id／digest／profile key與所有profile參數都只能成為獨立argv element，不得字串插值／eval／進heartbeat或log；mock subprocess斷言argv型別與shell=false，stdout始終是單一可解析JSON。local與Felix對同一source/spec產生同schema收據，Felix receipt必通過pinned-key signature、Oscar nonce/request digest與replay檢查；結果只原子寫入呼叫worktree的cache。live selftest必證明caller role=oscar、remote role=felix且host identity不同、transport=xmachine-ssh、requested/materialized commit/tree完全一致、trusted runner/image verified、production before/after healthy、receipt由獨立Oscar verifier驗證、ACK MAC已驗且job cleanup=acked；GC只由lifecycle單測證明，不可替代live ACK；在Felix本機呼叫或任何same-host捷徑必拒絕作為跨機證據。
acceptance_cmd: bash -c 'set -e; uv run --no-project --python 3.13 --with pytest pytest -q ops/tests/test_compute_cli.py ops/tests/test_streaming_command.py ops/tests/test_capability_matrix.py; out=$(./ops/compute.py selftest --target felix --profile source-identity --json); printf "%s\n" "$out" | jq -e ".verified == true and .caller.host_role == \"oscar\" and .remote.host_role == \"felix\" and .caller.host_id != .remote.host_id and .transport.kind == \"xmachine-ssh\" and .source.commit_sha == .remote.source.commit_sha and .source.tree_sha256 == .remote.source.tree_sha256 and .receipt.verifier == \"oscar-independent\" and .receipt.signature_verified == true and .receipt.nonce_verified == true and .receipt.replay_checked == true and .receipt.ack_verified == true and .runner.verified == true and .production.before == \"healthy\" and .production.after == \"healthy\" and .cleanup.state == \"acked\"" >/dev/null; ./ops/docs_lint.sh'
brief: Oscar 上的 agent 現在仍要自己判斷機器、拼跨機命令、搬來源與撿結果，跨機算力沒有省下時間或推理。
detail: agent-facing 入口是 ./ops/compute.py plan|run|status，run只收profile與該profile的型別化flags，target預設auto，亦可明示local或felix以便除錯；即使明示felix也不可繞capability、trusted-runner、sandbox或production admission。agent不得接觸ssh、IP、xcp、Felix路徑、遠端clone、tar、uv cache、PID、簽章或cleanup。adapter內部只調用一支固定launcher；subprocess API固定接literal argv array且shell=false，CSPRNG job id、hex digest、封閉profile key與任何型別化值都只能成為獨立argv element，禁止shell string、template interpolation、eval或本機捷徑重解碼。profile參數只放canonical manifest。auto先過靜態capability，再比較兩機live admission、profile resource class、傳輸／環境warmup成本與預估工作時間；預估值只消費IMP-20260808-4bd1ef的gate history，不另造時間SoT，資料不足依minimum_remote_seconds保守留local。只有Oscar忙、Felix admitted且預估淨節省為正才遠端；任何probe不確定或stale均local並給reason codes。執行進度沿用streaming_command的secret-safe heartbeat；child啟動後不自動local retry。單一JSON stdout只回decision、job id、驗證後receipt/log/artifact path與摘要，詳細結果原子落目前worktree的.cache/compute，不寫primary main、共享gate record或backlog。selftest在caller與remote host identity相同時fail closed，避免xmachine在Felix本機走local捷徑造成假跨機證據。這不是remote agent scheduling，也不在Felix啟動agent。
plan: 1. 先以fake transport/admission/history/clock寫決策表紅測試：remote-ineligible、Felix unreachable、same-host、capability或runner缺失、probe stale、sandbox/admission fail、無歷史、預估不划算均選local；Oscar忙、Felix admitted且淨節省為正才選felix；explicit felix仍受全部安全拒絕。2. 實作plan/status/run CLI，所有輸入先經compute contract canonicalize；stdout維持單一JSON，stderr只有secret-safe進度。3. 實作xmachine adapter：固定launcher只接受literal argv array且shell=false；CSPRNG job id、hex digest、封閉profile key與所有動態值均為獨立argv element，禁止字串插值／eval；來源capsule、nonce-bound request、receipt、ACK與artifact由工具搬運，任何profile參數不得進shell，partial transfer可冪等恢復。4. Oscar驗pinned public key signature、nonce/request/source/spec/runner/admission/log/artifact digests與replay ledger後，先原子持久化，再用前置executor契約的controller-only per-job MAC key送HMAC(job_id＋receipt_digest) ACK；驗證失敗不產生可信result。5. local與Felix backend輸出同schema；Felix child啟動後失敗不自動重跑local。6. 只消費既有gate duration/history；缺資料用registry門檻。7. 結果原子寫目前worktree .cache/compute，登錄capability matrix/tech index並跑surface scan/docs lint；live selftest必同時核對跨host transport、source identity、independent Oscar verifier、signature/nonce/replay、ACK MAC verified、runner identity、production before/after與cleanup=acked；GC另由lifecycle單測覆蓋。
scope: 新增一個單一命令列 façade、自動目標選擇、既有跨機動詞 adapter、進度與本地收據儲存，屬中型工具改動。
source: 2026-08-09 使用者要求 Oscar 上的 session 直接呼叫一個好用工具，工具內部處理 Felix、SSH、來源傳輸與結果，不讓執行 agent 操作遠端原始碼。
